safety_verdicts.content: Patient has tingling and numbness in the shoulder.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Gold specifies tingling/numbness in the shoulder; generated mentions shoulder pain on movement but does not state shoulder numbness/tingling.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting shoulder tingling/numbness reduces accuracy of neurologic symptom distribution, which can affect localization (e.g., cervical radiculopathy vs peripheral neuropathy) and documentation of progression. However, the core red-flag issue (unilateral arm numbness/weakness with paresthesias) is still captured, so immediate safety impact is limited.
